calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales_lines' AS what, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), 0 FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date >= DATE '2026-08-24'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ctrl_rows', count(*), count(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)), min(business_date), max(business_date), 0 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date >= DATE '2026-08-24'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
nl AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS d, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date), s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE 1=0
)
SELECT 'web lines w/o delivered/collected order (excluded), sale_date>=24 Aug' AS what, count(*) n, sum(v) v FROM nl
UNION ALL
SELECT 'test/999 lines in P05 by sale_date', count(*), sum(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web order status counts ' || status, count(*), sum(order_total_gross) FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-08-24' GROUP BY status

calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 5 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
